decisive_finding.reproduction: After consuming IDs in physical root R, a caller kept the same root and IDs but substituted candidate repository digest and rebound the receipt; a fresh mediator accepted the same IDs in the caller-selected partition.
decisive_finding.cause: Tombstones partitioned on candidate-supplied repository identity that mediation did not derive or verify against the actual root.

required_correction: derive canonical repository URI and digest internally from the actual root before mint final lookup or consumption
share one no-alias canonical resolver between semantic validation and mediation
reject candidate URI or digest mismatch symlink alias lexical alias missing or non-directory roots
reject root swap between initial and final without consuming authority
prove separation only with two independently canonicalized real roots
root_disposition: The proposal remains non-authoritative. Canonical root derivation is modeled in process; canonical durable runtime enforcement remains required before adoption.
no_claim_statement: This REWORK decision authorizes no external effect and changes no adopted contract, product behavior, claim ceiling, readiness, release, node closure, or goal-completion state.
